title: Checkbox toggles by array index instead of task id
summary: app/page.tsx calls toggle(String(tasks.indexOf(task))), so the PATCH targets /api/tasks/<index> (0) instead of the task id and the API answers 404. The done flag never flips, the counter keeps reading 1, and the "completing a task..." test fails at its counter assertion.

expectedFailure.testTitle: completing a task updates the counter and the Done filter
